summary: The FFLA index lists a gone tower in San Augustine County. TopoQuest names a Jackson Hill Lookout locale there. No history found.

facts.status_note: FFLA lists it as gone. No source gives a removal date or describes the site today.

evidence.supports: Listed as a tower in San Augustine County with status Gone
evidence.quote: Jackson Hill San Augustine 31.30605 -94.29207 Tower Gone

evidence.supports: A place record named Jackson Hill Lookout, a locale in San Augustine County at about 377 ft
evidence.quote: Jackson Hill Lookout is a locale located in San Augustine County, TX at N31.306299° W94.291866° (WGS84/NAD83) and at an elevation of 377 ft MSL.

notes_for_editor: No story written. The sources give a name, a location and a gone status, with no build, staffing or fate history. The TopoQuest entry is a map place name and does not say a tower stood there. Searches found no Forest Service or Texas link. Two Forest Service gallery records from SFA ScholarWorks (nfgt_general 879, 1478) are for other forests. The Texas A&M Forest Service history page returned HTTP 403 to fetch_text. Unchecked leads: the Cavallerano book Fire in the Piney Woods, the Angelina National Forest photo collection, and the FFLA San Augustine rows (the cached county list was truncated).
